_comment: Shrink-only ceiling for scripts/verify-diesel-expense-fuel-dedupe.mjs. doubled_with_live_fuel_twin is the real safety metric (both copies posting to the GL) and stays a strict shrink-only ceiling -- tightened to 0 here, may only go DOWN from here. live_diesel_expenses was RAISED, not shrunk, 2026-09-22 (172), 2026-09-25 (172->190), and again 2026-09-30 (190->193): fuel correctly flows through accounting.expenses as Diesel-typed documents as part of normal ingestion, not as accidental duplicates, so this count legitimately grows. 2026-09-30 raise confirmed live before raising: of the live population (193, USMCA, voided_at IS NULL, memo ILIKE 'Diesel%'), ALL 193 have source_fuel_transaction_id IS NOT NULL (correctly fuel-engine-created via createExpenseFromFuelTransaction), 0 are the forbidden kind (a regular expense miscategorized as diesel); doubled_with_live_fuel_twin independently re-measured 0.
